blogTitle: How to Incorporate Wall Art into Your Home Office
videoTitle: How to Incorporate Wall Art into Your Home Office
script:
How to Incorporate Wall Art into Your Home Office

[warmly] You know that feeling when you sit down to work and your walls are just… bare? Today we're covering everything you need — choosing art, placing it, colour, framing, scaling, and a few questions people always ask…

So the FIRST thing to ask yourself is — what atmosphere do you actually want in your office? Most people want calm and focused, not chaotic…

For themes — natural ones are honestly the BEST. Botanical prints, soft landscapes, gentle abstracts… they genuinely calm your nerves while you work, you know?

Now — motivational art with bold words can give you an energetic BOOST, but for deep focus, calming landscapes or minimalist prints are usually the better call…

Placement is HUGE — hang your art at eye level, roughly 145 to 155 centimetres from the floor to the centre of the piece… it makes such a difference to how the room feels

And if you do a gallery wall — a little tip I love: plan the whole layout on the FLOOR first before a single nail goes in…

[excited] Here's the thing about colour — the RIGHT palette in your wall art can literally do the work of an entire room colour scheme, pulling EVERYTHING together…

Style matters too — Scandi offices love minimalist nature prints, modern spaces suit geometric abstracts, and rustic or farmhouse offices? Botanical prints and vintage maps are PERFECT…

For framing — light wood or slim metal works brilliantly in modern and Scandi spaces… and if your desk is oak, a warm wood frame just TIES everything together beautifully

Canvas prints add warmth and depth — great for landscapes and abstracts… mounted prints are sharp and modern… and glass framed art gives that classic, clean finish

Scaling is something people ALWAYS get wrong — one oversized print on a wide wall can feel spot-on, but five tiny prints scattered around? Just looks lost…

[gently] And the wall behind your desk is PRIME real estate — especially if you're on video calls… a single considered piece behind you reads as professional without being distracting

Trust me — a well-planned gallery wall can completely transform a home office… consistent frames, balanced spacing, planned layout… that's all it takes, really

Colour psychology — soft BLUES and greens genuinely support focus and reduce stress… which is exactly why botanical and landscape art works so well in a home office…

If you've already got an established interior concept — your art should SPEAK to it… use the art to echo your existing materials and accent colours rather than fighting them

A little practical tip — keep art out of direct sunlight and wipe frames with a soft DRY cloth… it keeps everything looking fresh for years

[softly] So to pull it all together — calm themes, eye-level placement, colours that echo your room, proportional sizing… that's really the WHOLE formula for a workspace that feels good

And people also ask — honestly, three common ones: what size for a small office, can I mix styles, and should art match my desk colour… and the short answers are: go LARGE, keep frames consistent, and echo not match

Now — these are some of my absolute FAVOURITE picks for a home office wall… let's have a look

Tropical prints are brilliant for bringing that calm, nature-forward energy into a home office… honestly one of my favourites for a Scandi or modern space

Another gorgeous set — soft tropical artwork that adds DEPTH and warmth to a home office without ever feeling overwhelming… trust me on this one

This set is PERFECT for that understated, editorial home office look — clean, cohesive, and really well proportioned for a wall above a standard desk

[warmly] And this last one — a beautiful framed set that works across so many styles… a really CONSIDERED finish for any home office wall

Did you know styling your home doesn't have to be guesswork?

We've built a free set of Home Decor tools and styling guides…

From colour theory and design principles to gallery wall layouts and art sizing. Download them all from our site!

Find all you need to transform your home into a calming oasis!

Happy Decorating!
